scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Euclidean metric on the displayed unit-incidence bistar realization and integer a,b >=2; no general tree or weighted-edge theorem. Possible earlier equivalent graph-Lipschitz variance formulation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp Euclidean inballs and contact-facet transitions for bistar symmetric edge polytopes
